input: If God is good, why evil, hiddenness, hell, and worship-worthiness all at once?

bridge_terms.D0: The surface discourse contains several downstream claims.
bridge_terms.PsiN: The encoded state records a single load-bearing moral tribunal with dependent hiddenness, punishment, and worship-worthiness routes.
bridge_terms.expanded_IR: The expanded bridge maps kappa and Delta-kappa to the existing collapse_radius field and post_render_gate reread decision.
bridge_terms.kappa: The collapse radius is the downstream dependency set that must be reread after the load-bearing burden lands.
bridge_terms.Delta-kappa: The dependency-radius change is consumed by R(H, Delta) before STOP/HOLD/PARTIAL/RECURSE.
bridge_terms.burden_notation: The hiddenness, punishment, and worship-worthiness pieces are submoves or held dependent routes unless reread licenses a new burden.
bridge_terms.operator_signature: Each active submove must have target -> operation -> result.
bridge_terms.expanded_R: R(H, DeltaB{heart,xi,Omega,sigma,mu}, Delta-kappa) chooses PARTIAL here because limits prevent all dependent routes from landing.

control_effects.hold_release: Release the load-bearing tribunal operation and hold downstream content that remains inside kappa.
control_effects.burden_selection: Do not split hiddenness/hell/worship into independent burdens before the moral tribunal lands.
control_effects.reread: Delta-kappa forces held downstream routes through the post-render gate.
control_effects.partial_behavior: If the response budget cannot land the newly eligible downstream route, mark PARTIAL instead of STOP.

ir_projection.load_bearing_node: moral tribunal judges divine goodness before hiddenness, hell, or worship can be read cleanly
ir_projection.collapse_radius: hiddenness, hell/punishment, worship-worthiness, and source-status routes depend on the moral tribunal landing
ir_projection.what_remains_live: hiddenness and worship-worthiness remain input-anchored after the tribunal operation

post_render_gate.cleared_this_pass: moral tribunal no longer governs as neutral judge
post_render_gate.remaining_live_distortions: hiddenness and worship-worthiness remain inside Delta-kappa
